snippet.title: We are live Momora!- Trailer
snippet.description:
We are live Momora! is a 3D Orthogonal  Platformer with inspirations of weird games like FunnyPizzaLand or Harold's Walk to make a fun weird experiment.You control Momora, a half ""human"" half peg-top, protagonist of the best show of G.O.D television enterprises!, Please G.O.D so he doesn't punish you and create the best show ever seen!

Link to the game: https://strawberrychar.itch.io/we-are-live-momora

Credits:

granularbiomes-Music

StrawberryChar-Video editing,Creator, 3D modeler, animator

Abyssal Siren- Drawings
